name: Amdocs
description: Amdocs offers comprehensive BSS/OSS and CPQ solutions that compete directly with Skyvera while also serving as a telecom infrastructure vendor competing against Telefonica's services.
strengths: Established enterprise-grade platform with 25+ years of telecom industry expertise
Deep integration capabilities with existing legacy telecom systems and ERP platforms
Large professional services ecosystem with proven deployment methodologies
weaknesses: Heavy on-premise architecture with slower cloud-native Salesforce integration compared to Skyvera's native CPQ
Complex implementation timelines (12-18 months typical) versus Skyvera's faster deployment
Higher total cost of ownership due to extensive customization requirements and legacy infrastructure dependencies

name: Oracle Communications
description: Oracle Communications provides integrated BSS, CPQ, and network management solutions that directly compete with Skyvera's Salesforce-native platform while offering enterprise telecom infrastructure services.
strengths: Massive installed base across major global telecom operators with 99.99% uptime SLAs
Vertically integrated portfolio spanning billing, provisioning, and revenue management
Strong financial backing and continuous R&D investment in AI-powered pricing optimization
weaknesses: Limited native Salesforce integration requiring extensive middleware and custom APIs versus Skyvera's out-of-box Salesforce compatibility
Steep learning curve and vendor lock-in reducing flexibility for multi-cloud strategies
Higher licensing and infrastructure costs making it less accessible for mid-market German telecom operators
